Loading data
```{r}
save <- here("Morphology", "Morphology Script", "graphs")

# Excel file path
excel_file <- here("data", "rawdata.xlsx")

# Read reconstruction data
data <- read_excel(
  excel_file,
  sheet = "Reconstructions"
)
```
This is for cell counts and the splitting of the cells. 
```{r}
# Create initial data subset (if needed)
data_subset <- data[, c("File","somaarea", "somadiameter","zdepth1", "zdepth2", "df", "2df", "dfdiameter", "2dfdiameter","equaldf", "combineddf", "function", "monoorbi", "asymmetry", "branchlengthsum", "branchlengthn", "convexhull", "depth", "tips", "zcoordinate", "density", "complexity")]

# Default Group to Unclassified
data$Group <- "Unclassified"

# Keep only rows with all needed info
classifiable <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(`dfdiameter`),
    !is.na(`function`),
    !is.na(`monoorbi`),
    !is.na(`asymmetry`),
    !is.na(`df`),
    !is.na(`2df`))

# Initialize Group column
classifiable$Group <- NA

# Split mono vs bi
mono_rows <- classifiable$monoorbi == 1
bi_rows <- !mono_rows

# -------------------
# MONOSTRATIFIED
# -------------------
# For monostratified, check dfdiameter
mono_df_large <- mono_rows & classifiable$dfdiameter >= 225
mono_df_small <- mono_rows & classifiable$dfdiameter < 225

# For large dfdiameter: Alpha, split ON/OFF
classifiable$Group[mono_df_large] <- ifelse(
  classifiable$zdepth1[mono_df_large] <= 16,
  "Alpha ON",
  "Alpha OFF"
)

# For small dfdiameter: Non-Alpha, split Asymmetric/Non-Alpha
classifiable$Group[mono_df_small] <- ifelse(
  classifiable$asymmetry[mono_df_small] < 0.30,
  "Asymmetric",
  "Non-Alpha"
)

# -------------------
# BISTRATIFIED
# -------------------
# For bistratified, compare df vs 2df
bi_equal <- bi_rows & (abs(classifiable$df - classifiable$`2df`) / classifiable$df <= 0.20)
bi_unequal <- bi_rows & !bi_equal

classifiable$Group[bi_equal] <- "Equal Bistratified"
classifiable$Group[bi_unequal] <- "Unequal Bistratified"

# -------------------
# Join back with original data
# -------------------
data_with_groups <- data %>%
  select(-Group) %>%
  left_join(
    classifiable[, c("File", "Group")],
    by = "File"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(is.na(Group), "Unclassified", Group))


wb <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(excel_file)

# Write updated data into Reconstructions sheet
openxlsx::writeData(
  wb,
  sheet = "Reconstructions",
  x = data_with_groups
)

# Save back to the same workbook
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  excel_file,
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
test_summary <- data.frame(
  Parameter = character(),
  Normal = logical(),
  Bartlett_p = numeric(),
  Recommended_Test = character(),
  Recommended_Posthoc = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

parameters <- c(
  "zdepth1", "zdepth2", "somadiameter", "dfdiameter", "2dfdiameter",
  "combineddf", "equaldf", "asymmetry", "branchlengthsum",
  "branchlengthn", "tips", "convexhull", "density",
  "complexity", "zcoordinate"
)

for (param in parameters) {

  cat("\nChecking:", param, "\n")

  # Use only the two bistratified groups for variables
  # that only apply to bistratified cells
  if (param %in% c("zdepth2", "2dfdiameter", "equaldf")) {

    filtered_data <- data_with_groups %>%
      filter(
        Group %in% c(
          "Equal Bistratified",
          "Unequal Bistratified"
        ),
        !is.na(.data[[param]])
      )

  } else {

    filtered_data <- data_with_groups %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(.data[[param]]),
        !is.na(Group),
        Group != "Unclassified"
      )
  }

  if (nrow(filtered_data) == 0) {
    cat("No data to analyze for", param, "\n")
    next
  }

  # Number of groups actually included
  n_groups <- dplyr::n_distinct(filtered_data$Group)

  # Shapiro-Wilk test within each group
  normality_results <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    group_modify(~ {

      if (nrow(.x) >= 3) {

        test_result <- tryCatch(
          shapiro.test(.x[[param]])$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )

        tibble(
          shapiro_p_value = test_result
        )

      } else {

        tibble(
          shapiro_p_value = NA_real_
        )
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  # All groups with valid Shapiro results must have p > 0.05
  valid_shapiro <- normality_results$shapiro_p_value[
    !is.na(normality_results$shapiro_p_value)
  ]

  is_normal <- length(valid_shapiro) > 0 &&
    all(valid_shapiro > 0.05)

  # Bartlett test only when normal
  bartlett_test <- NULL

  if (is_normal) {

    bartlett_test <- tryCatch(
      bartlett.test(
        as.formula(paste0("`", param, "` ~ Group")),
        data = filtered_data
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    variance_p_value <- if (!is.null(bartlett_test)) {
      bartlett_test$p.value
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

  } else {

    variance_p_value <- NA_real_
  }

  print(normality_results)

  if (is_normal && !is.null(bartlett_test)) {
    print(bartlett_test)
  } else {
    cat(
      "Skipped Bartlett's test due to non-normality ",
      "or insufficient data.\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Select overall test and follow-up test
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  if (!is_normal) {

    if (n_groups == 2) {
      recommended_test <- "Wilcoxon rank-sum test"
      recommended_posthoc <- "None: only two groups"
    } else {
      recommended_test <- "Kruskal-Wallis"
      recommended_posthoc <- "Dunn's test with BH correction"
    }

  } else if (
    !is.na(variance_p_value) &&
    variance_p_value > 0.05
  ) {

    if (n_groups == 2) {
      recommended_test <- "Student's two-sample t-test"
      recommended_posthoc <- "None: only two groups"
    } else {
      recommended_test <- "One-way ANOVA"
      recommended_posthoc <- "Tukey HSD"
    }

  } else {

    if (n_groups == 2) {
      recommended_test <- "Welch's two-sample t-test"
      recommended_posthoc <- "None: only two groups"
    } else {
      recommended_test <- "Welch's ANOVA"
      recommended_posthoc <- "Games-Howell"
    }
  }

  cat(
    "→ Use ", recommended_test,
    " for ", param,
    "\n→ Follow-up: ", recommended_posthoc,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  test_summary <- bind_rows(
    test_summary,
    data.frame(
      Parameter = param,
      Normal = is_normal,
      Bartlett_p = variance_p_value,
      Number_of_Groups = n_groups,
      Recommended_Test = recommended_test,
      Recommended_Posthoc = recommended_posthoc,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}

write.csv(
  test_summary,
  file = file.path(
    save,
    "Statistical_Test_Recommendations.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

test_summary
```
Loop for kruskal wallis
```{r}
# List of variables to analyze
variables <- c(
  "zdepth1", "zdepth2", "somadiameter", "dfdiameter", "combineddf",
  "asymmetry", "branchlengthsum", "branchlengthn", "tips",
  "density", "complexity", "zcoordinate"
)

y_labels <- c(
  "Z-depth 1",
  "Z-depth 2",
  "Soma diameter",
  expression("Dendritic field diameter" ~ µm^2),
  expression("Combined dendritic field" ~ µm^2),
  "Asymmetric index",
  "Branch length sum",
  "Branch length n",
  "Number of terminal tips",
  "Arbor density",
  "Arbor complexity",
  "Furthest zcoordinate"
)

# Fixed group order
desired_order <- c(
  "Alpha ON", "Alpha OFF", "Asymmetric",
  "Non-Alpha", "Equal Bistratified", "Unequal Bistratified"
)

# Heatmap order
x_order <- c(
  "Unequal Bistratified", "Equal Bistratified", "Non-Alpha",
  "Asymmetric", "Alpha OFF", "Alpha ON"
)
y_order <- x_order

# Fixed significance colors
sig_colors <- c(
  "****" = "#1A5A8B",
  "***"  = "#386C9C",
  "**"   = "#5C88B7",
  "*"    = "#A4C8E1",
  "ns"   = "#EEF3F7")

# ---------------------------------
# Save standalone significance legend ONCE
# ---------------------------------
legend_data <- data.frame(
  x = 1:5,
  y = 1,
  sig_bin = factor(c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"),
                   levels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
)

legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = sig_bin)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = sig_colors,
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Significance",
    labels = c(
      "****" = "p < 0.0001",
      "***"  = "p < 0.001",
      "**"   = "p < 0.01",
      "*"    = "p < 0.05",
      "ns"   = "ns"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  )

legend_only <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "significance_legend.pdf",
  plot = legend_only,
  path = save,
  width = 3,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)

# ---------------------------------
# Main loop
# ---------------------------------
for (i in seq_along(variables)) {

  var <- variables[i]
  y_label <- y_labels[i]

  # Filter data
  filtered_data <- data_with_groups %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(Group), Group != "Unclassified") %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = desired_order))

  # Kruskal-Wallis test
  kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(as.formula(paste(var, "~ Group")), data = filtered_data)
  print(kruskal_result)

  # Dunn's test
  dunn_result <- dunnTest(as.formula(paste(var, "~ Group")), data = filtered_data, method = "bh")

  # Save significant results
  significant_results <- dunn_result$res %>%
    filter(P.adj < 0.05) %>%
    select(Comparison, Z, P.adj)

   # Create pvalue folder if it doesn't exist
  dir.create(file.path(save, "pvalue"),
             recursive = TRUE,
             showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  write.table(
    significant_results,
    file = file.path(save, "pvalue", paste0("significant_results_loop_", var, ".txt")),
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE
  )
  # Summary statistics
  summary_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      se_value   = sd(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = desired_order))

  # Y-axis scaling
  max_value <- max(filtered_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max_value * 1.2

  # ---------------------------
  # Boxplot
  # ---------------------------
  boxplot <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Group, y = .data[[var]], color = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA, size = 1) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(fill = Group),
      color = "black",
      shape = 21,
      width = 0.15,
      size = 2,
      stroke = 0.8,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, y_max + 0.1))

  ggsave(
    paste0(var, "_kruskal.pdf"),
    plot = boxplot,
    path = save,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )

  # ---------------------------
  # Heatmap prep
  # ---------------------------
  heatmap_data <- dunn_result$res %>%
    select(Comparison, P.adj) %>%
    separate(Comparison, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " - ")

  heatmap_data_sym <- heatmap_data %>%
    bind_rows(heatmap_data %>% rename(group1 = group2, group2 = group1))

  heatmap_data_wide <- heatmap_data_sym %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group2, values_from = P.adj)

  heatmap_data_wide[is.na(heatmap_data_wide)] <- 1

  heatmap_long <- heatmap_data_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -group1, names_to = "group2", values_to = "p_value") %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        p_value < 0.0001 ~ "****",
        p_value < 0.001  ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01   ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05   ~ "*",
        TRUE             ~ ""
      ),
      sig_bin = case_when(
        p_value < 0.0001 ~ "****",
        p_value < 0.001  ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01   ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05   ~ "*",
        TRUE             ~ "ns"
      ),
      sig_bin = factor(sig_bin, levels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group1 = factor(group1, levels = x_order),
      group2 = factor(group2, levels = y_order)
    ) %>%
    filter(as.numeric(group1) >= as.numeric(group2)) %>%
    mutate(group1 = factor(group1, levels = rev(levels(group1))))

  # ---------------------------
  # Heatmap with discrete bins and NO legend
  # ---------------------------
  heatplot <- ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = group1, y = group2, fill = sig_bin)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = significance),
      color = "white",
      size = 10,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 0.5
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = sig_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL) +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "left")

  ggsave(
    paste0(var, "_heatmap.pdf"),
    plot = heatplot,
    path = save,
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )

  print(boxplot)
  print(heatplot)
}
```

```{r}
---------------------------
# Variables to analyze
# ---------------------------
variables <- c("2dfdiameter", "equaldf", "convexhull")

y_labels <- c(
  "2df diameter",
  "% difference between DF1 and DF2",
  expression("Convex hull" ~ µm^3)
)

# ---------------------------
# Group order
# ---------------------------
desired_order <- c(
  "Alpha ON",
  "Alpha OFF",
  "Asymmetric",
  "Non-Alpha",
  "Equal Bistratified",
  "Unequal Bistratified"
)

x_order <- c(
  "Unequal Bistratified",
  "Equal Bistratified",
  "Non-Alpha",
  "Asymmetric",
  "Alpha OFF",
  "Alpha ON"
)

y_order <- x_order

# ---------------------------
# Fixed significance colors
# dark -> light
# ---------------------------
sig_colors <- c(
  "****" = "#1A5A8B",
  "***"  = "#386C9C",
  "**"   = "#5C88B7",
  "*"    = "#A4C8E1",
  "ns"   = "#EEF3F7")


# ---------------------------
# Export legend ONCE
# ---------------------------
legend_data <- data.frame(
  x = 1:5,
  y = 1,
  sig_bin = factor(
    c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"),
    levels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")
  )
)

legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = sig_bin)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = sig_colors,
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Significance",
    labels = c(
      "****" = "p < 0.0001",
      "***"  = "p < 0.001",
      "**"   = "p < 0.01",
      "*"    = "p < 0.05",
      "ns"   = "ns"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  )

legend_only <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "significance_legend.pdf",
  plot = legend_only,
  path = save,
  width = 3,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)

# ---------------------------
# Main loop
# ---------------------------
for (i in seq_along(variables)) {
  
  var <- variables[i]
  y_label <- y_labels[i]
  
  # Start from original data each loop so modifications do not carry over
  plot_data <- data_with_groups
  
  # Special handling for equaldf
  if (var == "equaldf") {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(equaldf = ifelse(equaldf == 100, NA, equaldf))
  }
  
  # Filter data
  filtered_data <- plot_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(Group), Group != "Unclassified") %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = desired_order))
  
  # Keep only groups with at least 2 observations
  group_counts <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n >= 2)
  
  if (nrow(group_counts) < 2) {
    message("Skipping ", var, ": not enough valid groups with n >= 2")
    next
  }
  
  filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
    filter(Group %in% group_counts$Group) %>%
    droplevels()
  
  # Welch's ANOVA
  oneway_test_result <- tryCatch({
    oneway.test(
      as.formula(paste0("`", var, "` ~ Group")),
      data = filtered_data,
      var.equal = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Welch's ANOVA failed for ", var, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
  
  if (!is.null(oneway_test_result)) {
    print(oneway_test_result)
  }
  
  # Games-Howell post-hoc test
  games_howell_result <- tryCatch({
    games_howell_test(
      filtered_data,
      formula = as.formula(paste0("`", var, "` ~ Group")),
      conf.level = 0.95,
      detailed = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Games-Howell failed for ", var, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
  
  if (is.null(games_howell_result)) next
  
  # Save significant pairwise comparisons
  significant_results <- games_howell_result %>%
    filter(p.adj.signif != "ns")
  
  # Create pvalue folder if it doesn't exist
  dir.create(file.path(save, "pvalue"),
             recursive = TRUE,
             showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  write.table(
    significant_results,
    file = file.path(save, "pvalue", paste0("significant_results_loop_", var, ".txt")),
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE
  )
  
  # Summary stats
  summary_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      se_value   = sd(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = desired_order))
  
  # Y-axis scaling
  max_value <- max(filtered_data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max_value * 1.2
  
  # ---------------------------
  # Boxplot
  # ---------------------------
  boxplot <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Group, y = .data[[var]], color = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA, size = 1) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(fill = Group),
      color = "black",
      shape = 21,
      width = 0.15,
      size = 2,
      stroke = 0.8,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      limits = c(0, y_max + 0.1)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    paste0(var, "_welch.pdf"),
    plot = boxplot,
    path = save,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  # ---------------------------
  # Heatmap prep
  # ---------------------------
  heatmap_data <- games_howell_result %>%
    select(group1, group2, p.adj)
  
  heatmap_data_sym <- bind_rows(
    heatmap_data,
    heatmap_data %>% rename(group1 = group2, group2 = group1)
  )
  
  heatmap_data_wide <- heatmap_data_sym %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group2, values_from = p.adj)
  
  heatmap_data_wide[is.na(heatmap_data_wide)] <- 1
  
  heatmap_long <- heatmap_data_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -group1, names_to = "group2", values_to = "p_value") %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        p_value < 0.0001 ~ "****",
        p_value < 0.001  ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01   ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05   ~ "*",
        TRUE             ~ ""
      ),
      sig_bin = case_when(
        p_value < 0.0001 ~ "****",
        p_value < 0.001  ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01   ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05   ~ "*",
        TRUE             ~ "ns"
      ),
      sig_bin = factor(sig_bin, levels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")),
      group1 = factor(group1, levels = x_order),
      group2 = factor(group2, levels = y_order)
    ) %>%
    filter(as.numeric(group1) >= as.numeric(group2)) %>%
    mutate(group1 = factor(group1, levels = rev(levels(group1))))
  
  # ---------------------------
  # Heatmap
  # ---------------------------
  heatplot <- ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = group1, y = group2, fill = sig_bin)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = significance), color = "white", size = 5) +
    theme_void() +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = sig_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL) +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "left")
  
  ggsave(
    paste0(var, "_heatmap.pdf"),
    plot = heatplot,
    path = save,
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  print(boxplot)
  print(heatplot)
}
```

Summary table
```{r}

summary_table <- data_with_groups %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group), Group != "Unclassified") %>%  
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    mean_zdepth1 = mean(`zdepth1`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_zdepth1 = sd(`zdepth1`, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_zdepth2 = mean(`zdepth2`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_zdepth2 = sd(`zdepth2`, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_soma_diameter = mean(`somadiameter`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_soma_diameter = sd(`somadiameter`, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_dfdiameter = mean(dfdiameter, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dfdiameter = sd(dfdiameter, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_2dfdiameter = mean(`2dfdiameter`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_2dfdiameter = sd(`2dfdiameter`, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_equaldf = mean(equaldf, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_equaldf = sd(equaldf, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_asymmetry = mean(asymmetry, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_asymmetry = sd(asymmetry, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_density = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_density = sd(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_complexity = mean(complexity, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_complexity = sd(complexity, na.rm = TRUE),
    
  )

# Format table to display mean (SD), and replace "0 (0)" with "-" for `2df`
formatted_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    `Average z-depth1` = paste0(round(mean_zdepth1, 1), " (", round(sd_zdepth1, 1), ")"),
    `Average z-depth2` = paste0(round(mean_zdepth2, 1), " (", round(sd_zdepth2, 1), ")"),
    `Soma Diameter` = paste0(round(mean_soma_diameter, 1), " (", round(sd_soma_diameter, 1), ")"),
    `DF1 Diameter` = paste0(round(mean_dfdiameter, 1), " (", round(sd_dfdiameter, 1), ")"),
    `DF2 Diameter` = paste0(round(mean_2dfdiameter, 1), " (", round(sd_2dfdiameter, 1), ")"),
    `% difference between DF1 and DF2` = paste0(round(mean_equaldf, 1), " (", round(sd_equaldf, 1), ")"),
    `Asymmetry` = paste0(round(mean_asymmetry, 1), " (", round(sd_asymmetry, 1), ")"),
    `Density` = paste0(round(mean_density, 1), " (", round(sd_density, 1), ")"),
    `Complexity` = paste0(round(mean_complexity, 1), " (", round(sd_complexity, 1), ")"),
    `N` = N
  ) %>%
  select(Group, N, `Average z-depth1`, `Average z-depth2`, `Soma Diameter`, `DF1 Diameter`,  `DF2 Diameter`, `% difference between DF1 and DF2`, `Asymmetry`, `Density`, `Complexity`)

# Print the formatted table using kable
kable(formatted_table, col.names = c("Group", "N", "Average z-depth 1", "Average z-depth 2", "Soma Diameter", "DF1 Diameter", "DF2 Diameter", "% difference between DF1 and DF2", "Asymmetry", "Density", "Complexity"), 
      caption = "Summary of mean values for morphological characteristics by RGC type.")

# Export as CSV
write.csv(formatted_table, "summarytable.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
